concern_summary: This concern addresses the management and handling of holds on money requests, including user interface interactions allowing users to confirm or dismiss these holds.

This concern focuses on the approval process of held transactions, handling the resolution of hold reasons once financial requests are approved, including the management of optimistic updates for UI synchronization.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to managing the hold status of transactions, including checking if transactions are on hold, displaying relevant UI components, and processing related actions and updates when a transaction is placed on hold.

This concern defines the criteria and logic for determining if a financial request can be placed on hold or released from a hold, considering various factors such as its approval status and ownership.
This concern covers the processing and tracking of various financial transactions related to expense reports, ensuring consistency between held and settled expenses.
This concern involves processing hold report actions, creating updates for reports that are on hold, and managing hold actions based on the reports' current states.

This concern involves the validation and existence check of a transaction using its transaction ID, ensuring that only valid transactions are displayed to the user within the transaction preview context.

This concern focuses on the display and interaction logic of the Money Request Preview component, ensuring that it renders correctly based on specific conditions and provides users with the necessary transaction details and interactivity.
This concern involves monitoring held transactions within reports, ensuring compliance and validity of expense-related financial records.
